description: We’re Recycllux, a team that loves building, exploring new technologies, and solving real-world problems. For Dancing with the SARs, we want to turn satellite data into something useful, visual, and easy to understand. We’re looking for curious teammates interested in Earth science, SAR/GIS, AI/ML, web development, UI/UX, or design. Our idea is still evolving, so bring your skills, ideas, and creativity! 🚀🌍
